rationale: Adds a pre-tool review execution policy and fail-closed trace/report checks to prevent temporary canonical guard/limit patches being used as ordinary negative-input evidence. It changes only CI review tooling and documentation; product behavior and historical reviews remain unchanged.

summary.ru: Инструменты ревью отказывают в подмене реализации и проверяют execution trace до публикации отчёта.
summary.en: Review tools refuse implementation replacement and verify the execution trace before publishing a report.
